Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. stands as a distinguished chemical manufacturing and distribution company strategically located in the heart of Baroda, Gujarat, one of India's most prominent industrial corridors. Situated at 102 Sudhan Apartment, opposite Tejas School on Race Course, Baroda-7, the company has established itself as a reliable name in the chemical industry, serving diverse sectors with high-quality chemical solutions.

Operating from Gujarat, a state renowned for its robust chemical and petrochemical industry, Minol Acid And Chemicals benefits from the region's well-developed infrastructure, skilled workforce, and proximity to major ports and industrial hubs. The company specializes in the production and supply of various acids and chemical compounds, catering to industries ranging from pharmaceuticals and textiles to agriculture and manufacturing.

With a commitment to quality, safety, and environmental sustainability, Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. has built strong relationships with clients across India and beyond. The company's strategic location in Baroda provides excellent connectivity to major markets while ensuring efficient logistics and supply chain management. Their expertise in chemical processing, combined with adherence to stringent quality standards and regulatory compliance, has positioned them as a trusted partner for businesses seeking reliable chemical solutions. The company continues to evolve with changing market demands, investing in technology and innovation to meet the growing needs of various industrial sectors.
